hypotheses: Theorem 5.5 uses the source subgroup-lattice RWPRI condition without local double transitivity.
At field exponent fifteen the prime-exponent sum is two; only shapes 1–5 apply.
The separate Theorem 6.1 claim assumes RWPRI and local double transitivity, both supplied by the acquired L115 example.
contradiction: Only source shape 5 has the matching two Suzuki and one cyclic-by-four parabolic types, but it prescribes their Suzuki intersection to have order eight, not twenty. Shape 8 belongs to a different branch. The separate L115 rank-two family has valencies 65 and 8, disproving Theorem 6.1 even for bare incidence isomorphism.
qualifications: The old degree-105 rank-four extension is provenance, not an acquired claim.
The new witness check does not repeat the old search or enumerate the 2,132-element subgroup.
The forty-one classes inherited from L115 are specified-group Aut(G) classes; no bare-incidence count of forty-one is asserted.
Theorems 5.3 and 5.4 and general realization questions are not thereby settled.
common_qualifications: Each disposition refutes the literal fixed published assertion, rather than recovering every true result in that paper.
Classical Suzuki matrix, Bruhat, order, subfield-maximality and stated torus or automorphism facts remain explicitly attributed inputs; no new classification of Suzuki groups is claimed.
The older phase6/phase8 witness and proof history is preserved without a new-discovery or priority claim.
No claim about later editions, absence of errata, named open questions, new Lean declarations or compression measurements is made.
No replacement complete classification or complete corrected global count is asserted.
